text:
maria: Quick ask 15: can folks run a concise SKU smoke comparison A100 / H100 / L40S for 4k and 64k profiles? Keep it small: model=mistral-7b, batches=[1,2,8], seq=[4096,65536], quant=fp16 + int8 if stable. Please upload artifacts by Thu EOD so I can run an initial pass.

maria: Minimal outputs: bench stdout, perf summary CSV, nsys/nsight trace if p95 deviates >12%. Include the metadata header shown below in bench.log.

maria: metadata header (paste exactly):
```
sku: <A100|H100|L40S>
driver: <NVIDIA driver>
cuda: <cuda>
node: <bench-node-x>
commit: <git sha>
cfg: --model mistral-7b --seq <N> --batch <B> --quant <fp16|int8>
```

devin: @maria Ack. Which infra pool? prefer bench-node-1..4 (onprem) or cloud-gpu if node not available. mark cloud runs in sheet.

maria: yes, prioritize bench-node-* to reduce noise. if using cloud, note instance type and vCPU throttling.

alex: grabbing L40S on bench-node-2 now. Quick question: use warmup=80 for 64k or 120?

maria: warmup=120 for 64k, 40 for 4k. Also set max_tokens 1 per sample for throughput measurement.

ryan: For H100, I'll run with nsight-cu for traces. H100 stacks don't like nvprof. I'll try int8 but may fallback.

kai: FYI on L40S we've seen small host memcpy spikes when using the int8 fused kernels. If you see host->device memcpys >500MB/s for prolonged periods, @kai please ping me and I'll run a microtrace.

bench-bot: Job accepted: bench-queue job_id=6120 assigned to alex on bench-node-2. Report URL: https://internal-ci/reports/6120

alex: uploaded bench.log and perf-summary.csv to s3://redwood-inference/bench-uploads/1804127890/L40S/; sheet row updated. Driver 535.86.10, kernel 5.15.

ryan: H100 runs started on bench-node-1. Using cuda 12.2, driver 554.x. Will push artifacts to s3://redwood-inference/bench-uploads/1804127890/H100/ when done.

devin: quick FYI: the newer cuBLAS path changed GEMM tiling for 64k float matmuls on A100. Might alter p99 slightly. Flagging in case you see small regressions.

maria: good catch. If p95/p99 differs >12% vs baseline def456, include full nsight capture. I'll run scripts/sku_summary.py on Friday to collate.

alex: noticed a small outlier on batch=8, seq=65536 for L40S, p95 ~14% slower than baseline. Uploaded nsys trace to s3 and added keep=true metadata tag.

kai: thumbs. I'll take that nsys and run a microtrace to see whether memcpy or kernel launch stalls.

bench-bot: Reminder: bench-traces are auto-pruned after 21 days. To preserve, set metadata keep=true.

maria: timeline: finish runs by Thu EOD, I'll summarize Fri morning and post a short thread with graphs. If anything looks broken (OOMs, huge memcpy), tag me and @kai immediately.

ryan: ETA: H100 complete and uploaded by tomorrow noon. int8 path required a small runtime flag --use-quant-kernel to enable.

devin: logging note: please include top-of-log block showing GPU PCI topology and numactl output for node-level anomalies.

maria: yes include `lspci -vv` and `numactl --hardware` outputs in the artifact tarball.

alex: all set from L40S side. I'll re-run the batch=8 64k with --disable-fusion to see if it changes the p95.

kai: if disabling fusion helps, likely a kernel fusion bug on the L40S int8 path. I'll follow up with a short reproducer.

maria: perfect, thanks everyone. I'll collate and run the regression check and post summary with links to per-sku dashboards. :rocket:
